book.name: Love On The Run
book.introduction: Fresh out of college, Hannah Marshall covers her mom's night shift at a hotel, where she crosses paths with Miguel Elsher, who has been drugged. As fate would have it, she ends up spending a night in bed with him. Later, when Hannah applies for a position at Elsher Corporation, she becomes Miguel's assistant.As they spend more time together, a gradual romance blossoms between Miguel and Hannah.

book.name: Love in a Flash
book.introduction: Forced into marriage, Noelle reluctantly endures a series of blind dates until she meets Sebastian, a charming yet seemingly ordinary man. Enchanted by his allure, she marries him, anticipating a simple life. However, she soon discovers that Sebastian is not as he seems. Unveiling Sebastian's true identity as a billionaire, secrets begin to unravel, thrusting Noelle into an unexpected situation as she gradually uncovers the truth about his past...

book.name: Love Reset Game
book.introduction: After discovering her boyfriend's betrayal, Alison fakes amnesia for revenge—never expecting to fall for Carl, the man she's forced to pretend to be her boyfriend. As passion ignites between them, her vindictive best friend spirals into violent jealousy, threatening everything with deadly consequences in this twisted game of hearts and lies.

book.name: Love You To Death
book.introduction: Rebelling against her perfect life, high school senior cheerleader Brooke falls into a hot and heavy romance with transfer student and new QB Nate. Everything seems perfect. Until she discovers that Nate has a very dark side.

book.name: Love at Midnight
book.introduction: After signing the divorce agreement, Stella determined to break free from the past. However, she met Dereck at a bar, a handsome and mysterious man whose appearance injected new sparks into the story. Dereck timely helped Stella out of trouble, and the relationship between the two began to heat up.
